request: three data packs on offer from the network, all different. i type the price and the GB of each and it shows the price per GB and highlights the cheapest one
checklist: 1. price and GB of three packs
2. price per GB of each pack
4. shows how much cheaper than the dearest
program:
app "Data Packs" phone mint
state p1 money = 0
state g1 num = 5
state p2 money = 0
state g2 num = 20
state p3 money = 0
state g3 num = 50
let u1 = if(g1 > 0, p1 / g1, 0)
let u2 = if(g2 > 0, p2 / g2, 0)
let u3 = if(g3 > 0, p3 / g3, 0)
let best = min(u1, min(u2, u3))
row gap 2
  field p1 "Pack 1 price"
  field g1 "GB"
row gap 2
  field p2 "Pack 2 price"
  field g2 "GB"
row gap 2
  field p3 "Pack 3 price"
  field g3 "GB"
if p1 > 0 and p2 > 0 and p3 > 0
  section "Price per GB"
    row pad 1 radius 2 fill if(u1 = best, accent, soft)
      "Pack 1" grow
      round(u1 * 100) / 100 bold
    row pad 1 radius 2 fill if(u2 = best, accent, soft)
      "Pack 2" grow
      round(u2 * 100) / 100 bold
    row pad 1 radius 2 fill if(u3 = best, accent, soft)
      "Pack 3" grow
      round(u3 * 100) / 100 bold
  "Best pack is" round((1 - best / max(u1, max(u2, u3))) * 100) "% cheaper than the dearest." faint
else
  "Type all three prices." faint

request: father owned a house, a plot, some gold and a bank account. add each asset with its value, subtract debts, say if the mother is alive, and show shares of sons and daughters
checklist: 3. mother alive toggle gets one eighth
5. share for each son and daughter
program:
app "Estate assets" home green
table asset name text, value money
setting debts money = 0 "Debts to clear"
state mother bool = yes
state sons num = 2
state daughters num = 1
let net = max(sum(asset.value) - debts, 0)
let wife_part = if(mother, net / 8, 0)
let per = (net - wife_part) / max(sons * 2 + daughters, 1)
topbar "Estate assets", asset, "Add asset"
statcard net, "estate after debts"
section "Family"
  row gap 2
    toggle mother
    "Wife alive (gets 1/8)" grow
  "Sons" sons faint
  slider sons 0..6
  "Daughters" daughters faint
  slider daughters 0..6
if net > 0 and sons + daughters > 0
  section "Shares"
    if mother
      row
        "Wife" grow
        round(wife_part) bold
    row
      "Each son" grow
      round(per * 2) bold
    row
      "Each daughter" grow
      round(per) bold
list asset top 6, "No assets yet. Add the house, plot, gold and bank money."

state bill money = 0
state people num = 2
state tip pick Ten|Fifteen|Twenty = Fifteen
table split bill money, people num, each money
let pct = if(tip = Ten, 10, if(tip = Fifteen, 15, 20))
let total = bill * (1 + pct / 100)
section "The bill"
  field bill "Bill amount"
  choice tip
  row gap 2 align center
    "People" people bold grow
    button "-" tap set people = max(people - 1, 1)
    button "+" tap set people = min(people + 1, 30)
if bill > 0
  statcard round(total / people), "each person pays"
  "Tip is" round(bill * pct / 100) "at" pct "%" faint
  button "Save this split" fill accent tap add split bill = bill, people = people, each = round(total / people)
else
  "Type the bill above to see what each person pays." faint
section "Earlier splits"
  each split top 5 as s empty "No splits saved yet."
    row
      s.bill "for" s.people "people" grow
      s.each bold

request: I lose count of my prayers and my reps, and need something that keeps the tally
checklist: 2. prayers prayed today and day streak
3. week dots showing days with all five
4. rep counter for pushups, squats and situps
program:
app "Prayers and Reps" beads plum
table prayer name pick Fajr|Dhuhr|Asr|Maghrib|Isha = Fajr
table rep move pick Pushups|Squats|Situps = Pushups, n num 1..500
state mv pick Pushups|Squats|Situps = Pushups
"Prayers today" head
row gap 1
  each options prayer.name as p
    stack grow gap 0 align center
      p tiny color muted
      toggle prayer today where name = p
goal count(prayer today), 5, "prayers prayed today"
weekdots count(prayer on it) >= 5
"Reps" head
choice mv
row gap 1
  each [10, 20, 50] as k
    button "+" k grow tap add rep move = mv, n = k
section "Reps today", "in all:" sum(rep.n today)
  share rep today by move, sum(it.n), it.key

request: i need i want to lose weight
checklist: 2. starting weight and goal weight settings
3. shows kilos lost and kilos to go
4. line chart of weight over 90 days
program:
app "Lighter" scale purple
table weigh kg num 20..300 unit "kg"
setting start num = 80 "Starting weight (kg)"
setting target num = 70 "Goal weight (kg)"
let cur_kg = if(count(weigh) = 0, start, last(weigh.kg))
remind "Weigh in, same time, same scale" at 7:00 on mon
topbar "Lighter", weigh, "Log weight"
statcard start - cur_kg, "kg lost. Now" cur_kg "kg, goal" target "kg", start - target
section "Weight over time", "to go:" max(cur_kg - target, 0) "kg"
  trend weigh last 90 days sort at, it.kg
section "This week", "average" fixed(avg(weigh.kg week), 1) "kg"
  list weigh last 7 days, "No weigh-ins this week. Step on the scale and tap Log weight."

request: upstairs and downstairs share one electricity bill but have separate sub meters. enter the units of each floor and the total bill and show what each family pays, with the common charges split in half
program:
app "Floor split" bolt purple
state up num = 0
state down num = 0
state bill money = 0
state fixed money = 0
let units = up + down
let rate = (bill - fixed) / max(units, 1)
let up_pay = up * rate + fixed / 2
let down_pay = down * rate + fixed / 2
section "Bill"
  field bill "Total bill"
  field fixed "Fixed and common charges"
section "Sub meters (units)"
  field up "Upstairs"
  field down "Downstairs"
if units = 0 or bill = 0
  "Enter both meters and the bill to split it." faint
else
  statcard round(rate * 100) / 100, "per unit after fixed charges"
  row gap 2
    statcard round(up_pay), "upstairs pays"
    statcard round(down_pay), "downstairs pays"
  draw 100, 5
    rect 0, 0, 100 * up_pay / max(bill, 1), 5 fill accent
    rect 100 * up_pay / max(bill, 1), 0, 100 * down_pay / max(bill, 1), 5 fill warn
